name: SynthID Text
description: Statistical watermarking technique that embeds a signal in generated text by modulating token sampling probabilities. Detectable through distribution analysis against known parameters.
detectionMethod: Token distribution comparison against trained reference model

name: Fingerprint Alpha
description: Open statistical fingerprint detection method based on n-gram frequency deviation. Independent of any specific watermarking scheme, targets generic distribution anomalies.
detectionMethod: N-gram frequency analysis with chi-square test

name: Unicode Invisible Pattern
description: Detects invisible Unicode characters (zero-width spaces, joiners, directional marks) that may encode hidden information or serve as tracking watermarks in text.

name: C2PA Manifest
description: Content Authenticity Initiative manifest verification. Detects and validates cryptographic provenance signatures embedded in media files following the C2PA standard.
detectionMethod: Cryptographic manifest extraction and signature verification

name: Watermark-X
description: Proprietary statistical watermark detection targeting a known commercial text generation system. High specificity, low false positive rate on clean text.
detectionMethod: Log-likelihood ratio test against watermark distribution

name: Fingerprint-Z
description: Experimental pattern-based detection targeting structural repetition and formatting artifacts. Currently in research phase with limited validation.
detectionMethod: Structural pattern matching and repetition analysis

name: AudioMark Spectral
description: Spectral analysis fingerprint for audio content. Detects known inaudible watermark patterns embedded in synthetic audio through frequency domain analysis.
detectionMethod: FFT spectral analysis with known watermark correlation

name: ImageSignature Pixel
description: Pixel-level pattern detection for known image watermarking schemes. Analyzes spatial frequency patterns and noise floor characteristics.
detectionMethod: Spatial frequency analysis and noise floor profiling
